rv.q: Directed by Jade Lewis with a sure sense of rhythm, Superhoe is smart, sweary, authentic and provocative.

cn.t: Nicôle Lecky's one-woman show earns praise as a thrilling debut showcasing serious talent, though critics note some flaws in the execution of this monologue about a struggling artist.
